name: Glassmorphism
what_it_means: Glassmorphism layers translucent, frosted panels over vivid, blurred backgrounds. Background blur, a thin bright border and subtle transparency create depth and a sense of hierarchy, as if the interface were made of sheets of frosted glass floating above colour.
signature_moves: Vivid gradient blobs behind the glass
best_for: Fintech cards, music & weather apps, dashboards, OS-style UIs
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a finance dashboard for [APP] in Glassmorphism style. Background: deep indigo (#1B1640) with 3 large blurred gradient blobs (pink #FF5ACD, blue #5B8CFF, orange). Panels are frosted glass: background rgba(255,255,255,0.12), backdrop-filter: blur(20px), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.3), 24px radius, soft shadow. Include a glass credit card, a balance card with a line chart, and a recent transactions list. White text with 70% opacity for secondary text. Font: Inter / Plus Jakarta Sans. Make sure text contrast stays readable over the blur.
